exposure_rule: Read only the supplied compact historical claims and your own frozen initial report. The other initial report need not be read. Both initial hashes are identity pins supplied by the coordinator; they do not imply exposure or blind agreement in this later phase.

exposure_shape.details: Truthful actual exposure statement; this phase is not blind agreement

coverage: target_audit_records covers each exact protocol target ID once; pair_audit_records covers each exact protocol pair ID once, including unresolved or unchanged cases. Empty correction_claims and support_qualification_records are valid.

target_audit_record_shape.claim_ids: List of correction claim IDs, possibly empty
target_audit_record_shape.support_qualification_ids: List of qualification IDs, possibly empty
target_audit_record_shape.grounds: Concrete relation to the historical claim and retained uncertainty

pair_audit_record_shape.member_ids: Exact two sorted protocol target IDs
pair_audit_record_shape.claim_ids: List of correction claim IDs, possibly empty
pair_audit_record_shape.support_qualification_ids: List of qualification IDs, possibly empty
pair_audit_record_shape.grounds: Concrete claim comparison; do not create a new pair verdict by historical prose

correction_claim_shape.claim_id: Globally unique ID prefixed with reader label

old_fact_reference.artifact_sha256: Exact scientific SHA of old declared artifact

correction_claim_shape.old_literal: Exact old JSON field value, not a paraphrase
correction_claim_shape.corrected_source_fact: Concrete source-supported correction; disagreement or lower certainty alone is not a new contrary fact
correction_claim_shape.new_source_fact_refs: List of {reader:A_OR_B,json_pointer:/target_observations/INDEX/...} citing ONLY your own frozen initial facts
correction_claim_shape.native_locator_boxes: Native witness search rectangles relevant to each stated target
correction_claim_shape.dependent_edge_claims: List of dependent_edge_claim_shape records only when a specific accepted authority is actually implicated; otherwise empty

support_qualification_shape.qualification_id: Globally unique ID prefixed with reader label
support_qualification_shape.qualification: What the visible source supports, leaves unresolved, or no longer justifies; do not relabel uncertainty as a factual opposite
support_qualification_shape.own_initial_source_fact_refs: Only own initial source fact JSON references
support_qualification_shape.dependent_edge_claims: Exact source-authority dependency claims only, never automatic quarantine of all incident edges

dependent_edge_claim_shape.pair_id: Exact already accepted baseline edge ID
dependent_edge_claim_shape.accepted_edge_evidence_reference: Exact baseline graph edge evidence_reference object
dependent_edge_claim_shape.fact_dependency_grounds: Why this precise accepted authority relies on the questioned fact; identify whether final source evidence already accounts for it

limits: Original initial reports and D12 historical graph remain immutable. A later final source audit decides whether any literal correction or exact accepted-edge dependency is established. Repeated disagreement is not an erratum, and uncertainty does not automatically quarantine an edge. No extra comparison selection or source views are authorized by this format.
